items.title: How growing hotel groups share finance across properties
items.snippet: The article outlines how hotel groups can cluster finance functions across properties using shared teams and digital workflows, reducing headcount needs and improving group-level visibility.

items.title: Palazzo Segni, five centuries in the hands of Florentine families before joining the La Réserve collection
items.snippet: On Via Santo Spirito, the Palazzo Segni reopens after four years of work under the La Réserve brand. Reali, Segni, Sannini, Poccianti, Marciano: five families of merchants, men of letters, and industrialists have succeeded one another within these walls since the 15th century. The latest installment in our “One Building, One Destiny” series.

items.title: China revises visa application process for Indian travellers
items.snippet: China will begin directly accepting and processing visa applications and consular legalisation requests at its Embassy in New Delhi and Consulate General in Mumbai from October 26, 2026. The revised system will replace submissions through Chinese Visa Application Centres in New Delhi, Mumbai and Kolkata, which will stop accepting new applications from that date.

items.title: Goa unveils AI policy to diversify economy beyond tourism
items.snippet: Goa has unveiled its AI Policy 2026, backed by an innovation fund spread over five years, as the state seeks to develop its technology sector and reduce its dependence on tourism. The policy will run for three years, from 2026 to 2029, with a focus on developing artificial intelligence skills, supporting startups and attracting investment.

items.title: Uttar Pradesh launches 4-Day Dev Deepawali tourism experience
items.snippet: Uttar Pradesh is developing a four-day tourism experience around Dev Deepawali in Varanasi under its “Visit My State” campaign. The initiative brings together the city’s illuminated ghats, temple circuit, heritage walks and the Buddhist heritage of Sarnath.

items.title: Goa cuts aviation fuel VAT to 7%, IndiGo welcomes move
items.snippet: The Goa government has reduced the value-added tax (VAT) on aviation turbine fuel (ATF) to 7%, with the revised rate taking effect from October 24, 2026. The decision lowers the tax from the previous rate of 15%, which had been in place since March 2024. The move is expected to support the aviation sector by reducing the tax burden on fuel and strengthening the state’s air connectivity.

items.title: Hotel AI enters through the back door of chain hotels
items.snippet: Guests see neither the inspection checklist for their room, nor the handling of their towel request, nor the translation of the website, nor the portal where the franchisee gets their standards validated. Yet it is there, at Accor, H World, Radisson, and Wyndham, that AI and data are showing their first quantified results.

items.title: Diet Coke, beer makers get 6-month breather as govt extends aluminium can certification deadline
items.snippet: The government has extended the deadline for quality certification of aluminium beverage cans to April 2027. The extension provides manufacturers necessary time to increase production amidst growing demand. Many brands are experiencing supply challenges due to disruptions from the Middle East conflict. The beverage industry had hoped to produce additional cans but fell short of expectations.

items.title: As hotels seek quality talent, salaries of senior roles see substantial jump
items.snippet: Senior hospitality executives, particularly general managers, have seen substantial pay increases due to market demand and talent shortages. Compensation for luxury hotel general managers has risen by 40-75% over three years, reflecting a competitive environment. Key roles in operations, sales, and marketing are also witnessing significant pay growth.

items.title: HRAWI Takes FSSAI’s FoSTaC Programme To Lonavala
items.snippet: Taking its food safety training initiative to Lonavala, the Hotel And Restaurant Association (Western India) – HRAWI organized FSSAI’s latest Food Safety Supervisor Training in Advance Catering (FoSTaC) at Triose Boutique Hotel on 14th Oct, 2026, training forty-six hospitality professionals.
